properties.name: homefix.security.enabled
properties.description: Master switch; when {@code false} no security filters are registered.

properties.name: homefix.security.jwt-secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Must be at least 256 bits (32 bytes).

properties.name: homefix.security.rbac.endpoint-roles
properties.description: Map of {@code "METHOD /path"} → required roles. Evaluated in insertion order; first matching entry wins.
